job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

reviews.reason: This is an Orange County Employees Retirement System RFP issued in 2021, not the 2022 Hawaii ERS RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: Those who wish to be considered must submit their completed proposal, via email to the Point of Contact, by 5:00 p.m., PT, October 1, 2021.
